versions.content: It shall be possible to configure (configuration parameter FrIfPduUpdateBitOffset, see FrIf06071) for each PDU a dedicated PDU update bits in the FlexRay Frame.The FrIf module shall identify the position of the PDU update bits for each PDU using the information stored in configuration parameter FrIfPduUpdateBitOffset.
